# oaskit v0.14.0 - Table of Contents

> OpenAPI 3.1 validation, generation and utilities for for Elixir/Phoenix.

## Modules

- [Oaskit.TestWeb.OrvalController.UserBodySchema](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.TestWeb.OrvalController.UserBodySchema.md): Some body that needs to be respected by orval. Foo Bar Foo!

- Main API
  - [Oaskit](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.md): The main API to work with OpenAPI specifications.
  - [Oaskit.Controller](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Controller.md): Provides macros to define OpenAPI operations directly from controllers.

- Plugs
  - [Oaskit.Plugs.SpecProvider](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Plugs.SpecProvider.md): A plug to associate an OpenAPI specification with a group of routes in a
router or a controller.
  - [Oaskit.Plugs.ValidateRequest](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Plugs.ValidateRequest.md): This plug will match incoming requests to operations defined with the
`Oaskit.Controller.operation/2` or
`Oaskit.Controller.use_operation/2` macros and retrieved from a
provided OpenAPI Specification module.
  - [Oaskit.SpecController](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.SpecController.md): Controller for serving OpenAPI specifications in JSON format or Redoc UI.

- Error Handling
  - [Oaskit.ErrorHandler](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.ErrorHandler.md): A behaviour for validation errors handlers.

  - [Oaskit.ErrorHandler.Default](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.ErrorHandler.Default.md): The default error handler for validation errors.

- Testing
  - [Oaskit.Test](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Test.md): Provides the `valid_response/3` test helper to validate API responses in your
ExUnit tests.

- Utilities
  - [Oaskit.SpecDumper](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.SpecDumper.md): A helper to render an OpenAPI specification to JSON format.

  - [Oaskit.SpecValidator](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.SpecValidator.md): A helper module used to cast and validate OpenAPI specifications into structs.

- OpenAPI Spec 3.1
  - [Oaskit.Spec.Callback](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Spec.Callback.md): Representation of the [ Callback Object](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html#callback-object) in OpenAPI Specification.
  - [Oaskit.Spec.Components](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Spec.Components.md): Representation of the [ Components Object](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html#components-object) in OpenAPI Specification.
  - [Oaskit.Spec.Contact](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Spec.Contact.md): Representation of the [ Contact Object](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html#contact-object) in OpenAPI Specification.
  - [Oaskit.Spec.Discriminator](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Spec.Discriminator.md): Representation of the [ Discriminator Object](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html#discriminator-object) in OpenAPI Specification.
  - [Oaskit.Spec.Encoding](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Spec.Encoding.md): Representation of the [ Encoding Object](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html#encoding-object) in OpenAPI Specification.
  - [Oaskit.Spec.Example](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Spec.Example.md): Representation of the [ Example Object](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html#example-object) in OpenAPI Specification.
  - [Oaskit.Spec.ExternalDocumentation](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Spec.ExternalDocumentation.md): Representation of the [ External Documentation Object](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html#external-documentation-object) in OpenAPI Specification.
  - [Oaskit.Spec.Header](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Spec.Header.md): Representation of the [ Header Object](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html#header-object) in OpenAPI Specification.
  - [Oaskit.Spec.Info](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Spec.Info.md): Representation of the [ Info Object](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html#info-object) in OpenAPI Specification.
  - [Oaskit.Spec.License](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Spec.License.md): Representation of the [ License Object](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html#license-object) in OpenAPI Specification.
  - [Oaskit.Spec.Link](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Spec.Link.md): Representation of the [ Link Object](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html#link-object) in OpenAPI Specification.
  - [Oaskit.Spec.MediaType](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Spec.MediaType.md): Representation of the [ Media Type Object](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html#media-type-object) in OpenAPI Specification.
  - [Oaskit.Spec.OAuthFlow](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Spec.OAuthFlow.md): Representation of the [ O Auth Flow Object](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html#o-auth-flow-object) in OpenAPI Specification.
  - [Oaskit.Spec.OAuthFlows](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Spec.OAuthFlows.md): Representation of the [ O Auth Flows Object](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html#o-auth-flows-object) in OpenAPI Specification.
  - [Oaskit.Spec.OpenAPI](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Spec.OpenAPI.md): Representation of the [ Open Api Object](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html#open-api-object) in OpenAPI Specification.
  - [Oaskit.Spec.Operation](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Spec.Operation.md): Representation of the [ Operation Object](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html#operation-object) in OpenAPI Specification.
  - [Oaskit.Spec.Parameter](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Spec.Parameter.md): Representation of the [ Parameter Object](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html#parameter-object) in OpenAPI Specification.
  - [Oaskit.Spec.PathItem](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Spec.PathItem.md): Representation of the [ Path Item Object](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html#path-item-object) in OpenAPI Specification.
  - [Oaskit.Spec.Paths](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Spec.Paths.md): Representation of the [ Paths Object](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html#paths-object) in OpenAPI Specification.
  - [Oaskit.Spec.Reference](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Spec.Reference.md)
  - [Oaskit.Spec.RequestBody](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Spec.RequestBody.md): Representation of the [ Request Body Object](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html#request-body-object) in OpenAPI Specification.
  - [Oaskit.Spec.Response](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Spec.Response.md): Representation of the [ Response Object](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html#response-object) in OpenAPI Specification.
  - [Oaskit.Spec.Responses](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Spec.Responses.md): Representation of the [ Responses Object](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html#responses-object) in OpenAPI Specification.
  - [Oaskit.Spec.SchemaWrapper](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Spec.SchemaWrapper.md): A wrapper to embed JSON schemas of any supported type (modules, maps,
booleans) in an OpenAPI specification.

  - [Oaskit.Spec.SecurityRequirement](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Spec.SecurityRequirement.md): Representation of the [ Security Requirement Object](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html#security-requirement-object) in OpenAPI Specification.
  - [Oaskit.Spec.SecurityScheme](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Spec.SecurityScheme.md): Representation of the [ Security Scheme Object](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html#security-scheme-object-0) in OpenAPI Specification.
  - [Oaskit.Spec.Server](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Spec.Server.md): Representation of the [ Server Object](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html#server-object) in OpenAPI Specification.
  - [Oaskit.Spec.ServerVariable](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Spec.ServerVariable.md): Representation of the [ Server Variable Object](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html#server-variable-object) in OpenAPI Specification.
  - [Oaskit.Spec.Tag](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Spec.Tag.md): Representation of the [ Tag Object](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html#tag-object) in OpenAPI Specification.
  - [Oaskit.Spec.XML](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Spec.XML.md): Representation of the [ Xml Object](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html#xml-object) in OpenAPI Specification.

- Validation
  - [Oaskit.Validation.RequestData](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Validation.RequestData.md): A subset of a parsed and fetched `Plug.Conn` struct representing an HTTP
request, used by `Oaskit.Plugs.ValidateRequest` and
`Oaskit.Validation.RequestValidator`.

  - [Oaskit.Validation.RequestValidator](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Validation.RequestValidator.md): Base validation logic for requests, used by the `Oaskit.Plugs.ValidateRequest`
Plug.
  - [Oaskit.Validation.ResponseData](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Validation.ResponseData.md): A subset of a `Plug.Conn` struct representing an HTTP response, used by
`Oaskit.Test` and `Oaskit.Validation.ResponseValidator`.
  - [Oaskit.Validation.ResponseValidator](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Validation.ResponseValidator.md): Base validation logic for responses, used by the `Oaskit.Test`
helper.

- JSON Schema Extensions
  - [Oaskit.JsonSchema.Formats](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.JsonSchema.Formats.md): Implements formats described in https://spec.openapis.org/api/format.json for
`JSV`'s format validation. Some of the described formats are already
implemented in JSV directly.

- Exceptions
  - [Oaskit.Errors.InvalidBodyError](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Errors.InvalidBodyError.md)
  - [Oaskit.Errors.InvalidParameterError](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Errors.InvalidParameterError.md)
  - [Oaskit.Errors.MissingParameterError](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Errors.MissingParameterError.md)
  - [Oaskit.Errors.NormalizeError](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Errors.NormalizeError.md)
  - [Oaskit.Errors.UnsupportedMediaTypeError](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.Errors.UnsupportedMediaTypeError.md)
  - [Oaskit.SpecValidator.Error](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Oaskit.SpecValidator.Error.md)

## Mix Tasks

- [mix openapi.dump](https://oaskit.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Openapi.Dump.md): Writes an OpenAPI specification in a JSON file.
